lines.zh: 我抱着药箱，脚步放得很轻。
lines.en: I carry the powder crate and keep my steps very light.

lines.zh: 引线拖在地上，我得绕开。
lines.en: The fuse drags on the ground; I steer around it.

lines.zh: 这条街的客人认我的招牌。
lines.en: Customers on this street know my sign.

lines.zh: 脚下别踩火花，我提醒自己。
lines.en: Mind the sparks underfoot, I remind myself.

lines.zh: 一箱火药压得我肩膀发酸。
lines.en: A crate of gunpowder makes my shoulder ache.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走，怕颠着箱里的东西。
lines.en: I walk slowly so the crate does not jostle.

lines.zh: 前面有坑，绕过去再谈生意。
lines.en: There is a hole ahead; I detour before trading.

lines.zh: 靴底沾了灰，我在石头上蹭。
lines.en: My boot soles are dusty, so I scrape them.

lines.zh: 我把样品袋挂在腰侧晃。
lines.en: My sample pouch swings at my hip.

lines.zh: 步子短一点，火药可不等人。
lines.en: Shorter steps; gunpowder does not wait.

lines.zh: 我在摊子和仓库之间来回走。
lines.en: I pace between the stall and the storehouse.

lines.zh: 别挡道，这箱东西碰不得。
lines.en: Stand aside; this crate must not be bumped.

lines.zh: 走路时我数着箱里的响动。
lines.en: As I walk, I count the rattling in the crate.

lines.zh: 天色还早，我再去开一趟门。
lines.en: It is early; I will unlock the shop once more.

lines.zh: 我数着货架，火药还够卖。
lines.en: I count the shelves; there is powder left to sell.

lines.zh: 引线受潮了，得拿到太阳下。
lines.en: The fuses are damp; they need sun.

lines.zh: 这个价我已经压到底了。
lines.en: That price is already my lowest.

lines.zh: 补货的马车怎么还没来。
lines.en: Why has the restock cart not arrived?

lines.zh: 我把标签一张张贴正。
lines.en: I straighten the price tags one by one.

lines.zh: 有人碰过我的箱子，位置不对。
lines.en: Someone touched my crate; it sits wrong.

lines.zh: 三十点血，我得小心活着。
lines.en: Thirty health; I must live carefully.

lines.zh: 我擦掉柜台上的黑灰。
lines.en: I wipe the black soot off the counter.

lines.zh: 这罐硝石成色不错。
lines.en: This jar of saltpeter is good quality.

lines.zh: 风从门缝进来，我把箱子合上。
lines.en: Wind slips through the door; I close the crate.

lines.zh: 买家不来，我就磨刀切引线。
lines.en: No buyers, so I trim fuses with my knife.

lines.zh: 我的补货表写满了日子。
lines.en: My restock list is covered in dates.

lines.zh: 响声别太大，邻居会投诉。
lines.en: Not too loud; the neighbors will complain.

lines.zh: 我拍了拍口袋，零钱还在。
lines.en: I pat my pocket; the change is still there.

lines.zh: 你盯着炸药看，是想买吗？
lines.en: You keep staring at the explosives; buying?

lines.zh: 你的手别往引线上放。
lines.en: Keep your hand away from the fuse.

lines.zh: 我认得你，上次你砍过价。
lines.en: I remember you; you haggled last time.

lines.zh: 你眼里有火，我这正缺客人。
lines.en: There is fire in your eyes; I need customers.

lines.zh: 想换什么，先报个价。
lines.en: Tell me your price before we trade.

lines.zh: 你这一身灰，刚从矿里上来？
lines.en: You are all soot; just back from the mines?

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我身上有火药味。
lines.en: Not too close; I smell of gunpowder.

lines.zh: 你在找的东西，我摊上有。
lines.en: What you seek is on my stall.

lines.zh: 我抬眼打量你的钱袋。
lines.en: I glance at your coin purse.

lines.zh: 你的剑不错，可惜不换。
lines.en: Nice sword, but it is not for trade.

lines.zh: 我看着你，先把箱子挪到身后。
lines.en: I watch you and slide the crate behind me.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，价格可不会降。
lines.en: What are you smiling at? The price stands.

lines.zh: 你想问路，还是想问价？
lines.en: Are you asking directions or prices?

lines.zh: 我朝你点头，手上还按着箱盖。
lines.en: I nod at you, hand still on the crate lid.

lines.zh: 你这副打扮，不像来买东西。
lines.en: Dressed like that, you aren't here to buy.

lines.zh: 先看货，别看我手上的引线。
lines.en: Look at the goods, not the fuse in my hand.

lines.zh: 别打脸，我还得见客人。
lines.en: Spare my face; customers must still know me.

lines.zh: 这一下够我赔三天货。
lines.en: That blow costs me three days of goods.

lines.zh: 我身上只有三十点血。
lines.en: I have only thirty health to spare.

lines.zh: 疼死我了，箱子先护住。
lines.en: That hurts; guard the crate first.

lines.zh: 秤盘凹了，你得赔。
lines.en: The scale pan is dented; you must pay.

lines.zh: 我咬牙，把货往身后推。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and push the goods back.

lines.zh: 我这一行，挨打也算本钱。
lines.en: In this trade, bruises count as capital.

lines.zh: 别打了，价钱好商量。
lines.en: Stop hitting; the price is negotiable.

lines.zh: 伤口沾了硝石，火辣辣。
lines.en: Saltpeter in the wound burns sharply.

lines.zh: 我还站着，摊子就不能倒。
lines.en: I am still standing, so the stall stays up.

lines.zh: 那袋火药，你从哪弄来的？
lines.en: Where did you get that sack of powder?

lines.zh: 你手里那块硝石很干净。
lines.en: That saltpeter in your hand is clean.

lines.zh: 拿绿宝石出来，我给你打折。
lines.en: Show me emeralds and I will discount.

lines.zh: 我闻到硫磺了，真香。
lines.en: I smell sulfur; that is a fine scent.

lines.zh: 那根引线我要了，多少钱？
lines.en: I want that fuse; how much?

lines.zh: 别晃，我看不清你的货。
lines.en: Stop waving; I cannot see your goods.

lines.zh: 你这包东西，值得开个价。
lines.en: That bundle of yours deserves an offer.

lines.zh: 好货在眼前，我手就痒。
lines.en: Good goods in sight make my hands itch.

lines.zh: 让我摸一下那根导火索。
lines.en: Let me touch that detonating cord.

lines.zh: 我用三箱货换你手上那件。
lines.en: I will trade three crates for what you hold.

lines.zh: 别撞，箱子里全是火药。
lines.en: Do not bump me; the crate is full of powder.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，箱盖差点开。
lines.en: I step back; the lid nearly opened.

lines.zh: 撞坏了货，你赔得起吗？
lines.en: Can you pay for goods you break?

lines.zh: 哎，我的样品撒了一地。
lines.en: Hey, my samples are all over the ground.

lines.zh: 别碰我腰上那包炸药。
lines.en: Mind the charge packs on my belt.

lines.zh: 我扶住箱子，先看有没有裂。
lines.en: I steady the crate and check for cracks.

lines.zh: 别挤，摊子就这么宽。
lines.en: Do not crowd; the stall is this narrow.

lines.zh: 这一下撞掉我半天的利润。
lines.en: That bump cost me half a day's profit.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，怕碰出火星。
lines.en: I turn aside, afraid of striking sparks.

lines.zh: 你再撞，我可要收赔偿。
lines.en: Bump me again and I will charge damages.

lines.zh: 家里那口子管账，我管火药。
lines.en: My partner keeps books; I keep the powder.

lines.zh: 等这摊收了，我回家吃饭。
lines.en: When the stall closes, I go home to eat.

lines.zh: 孩子别碰雷管，我说过几次。
lines.en: Kids, keep off the detonators; I have said so.

lines.zh: 我们两口子守这间小店。
lines.en: My spouse and I mind this little shop.

lines.zh: 后代得学会认货，不然吃亏。
lines.en: Our young must learn the goods or get cheated.

lines.zh: 我攒的钱，够给孩子买张床。
lines.en: My savings can buy our child a bed.

lines.zh: 夜里有伴守着，箱子才安心。
lines.en: With a partner on watch, the crates feel safe.

lines.zh: 这门手艺，我想传下去。
lines.en: I want to pass this trade down.

lines.zh: 它数钱比我快，我认了。
lines.en: It counts coins faster than I do.

lines.zh: 两个人补货，能少跑几趟。
lines.en: Two people restocking means fewer trips.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的引线，我捡了。
lines.en: A fuse fell; I pick it up.

lines.zh: 这枚绿宝石是谁掉的？
lines.en: Whose emerald is this on the ground?

lines.zh: 我把散落的硝石收进袋。
lines.en: I gather the scattered saltpeter into a bag.

lines.zh: 有人掉了钱，我先替他收着。
lines.en: Someone dropped coins; I will hold them.

lines.zh: 这截导火索还能用，别浪费。
lines.en: This cord is still usable; do not waste it.

lines.zh: 地上有块铁片，正好当配重。
lines.en: An iron scrap makes good ballast.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，先护住腰间的箱。
lines.en: Bending down, I guard the crate at my waist.

lines.zh: 这包东西没人认，就归我。
lines.en: If no one claims this bundle, it is mine.

lines.zh: 我捡起来看看成色再收。
lines.en: I pick it up and check its quality first.

lines.zh: 掉的若是火药，那可真要命。
lines.en: If powder were dropped, that would be deadly.

lines.zh: 你举着剑过来，我可不傻。
lines.en: You come with a drawn sword; I am not blind.

lines.zh: 我看清你了，是来买东西的吗？
lines.en: I see you now; are you here to buy?

lines.zh: 有人在附近磨刀，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone is sharpening a blade nearby.

lines.zh: 那个影子一直跟着我的摊子。
lines.en: That shadow keeps following my stall.

lines.zh: 我把最贵的货先收进箱子。
lines.en: I pack the priciest goods into the crate first.

lines.zh: 你要动手，我这身子可不禁打。
lines.en: If you swing, this body will not last.

lines.zh: 附近有危险，我先关门。
lines.en: Danger nearby; I will shut the shop.

lines.zh: 谁在那边探头探脑？
lines.en: Who is peeking over there?

lines.zh: 我盯住你手里的家伙。
lines.en: I fix my eyes on what you carry.

lines.zh: 客人还是劫匪，走近点我才知道。
lines.en: Customer or robber? Come closer and I will know.

lines.zh: 你还没走，我就一直看着你。
lines.en: You have not left; I keep watching you.

lines.zh: 别在我摊前晃，会影响生意。
lines.en: Do not loiter by my stall; it hurts trade.

lines.zh: 我手按在箱盖上，随时能跑。
lines.en: My hand is on the lid, ready to run.

lines.zh: 你的脚步近了，我的心也紧了。
lines.en: Your steps come closer; my heart tightens.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，怕你顺手拿货。
lines.en: I do not blink, lest you pocket my goods.

lines.zh: 你绕到左边，我就转到右边。
lines.en: You circle left; I shift right.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，嘴里还在报价。
lines.en: I stare at you while still quoting prices.

lines.zh: 这么近的距离，火药很危险。
lines.en: At this range, gunpowder is dangerous.

lines.zh: 我退到柜台后面，安心一点。
lines.en: I retreat behind the counter, feeling safer.

lines.zh: 你要买就买，别一直杵着。
lines.en: Buy or leave; do not just stand there.

lines.zh: 我抡起空箱子砸过去。
lines.en: I swing an empty crate at you.

lines.zh: 我先动手，账回头再算。
lines.en: I strike first; we settle the bill later.

lines.zh: 这一下我用的是扫把。
lines.en: That hit came from my broom.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，只想脱身。
lines.en: I shove you once, just to get free.

lines.zh: 我的拳头不重，火药才重。
lines.en: My fist is light; the powder is heavy.

lines.zh: 打坏我的货，你就得赔。
lines.en: Break my goods and you will pay.

lines.zh: 我砸偏了，箱角擦过你肩。
lines.en: I miss; the crate corner grazes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一棍挡开你的剑。
lines.en: This stick knocks your sword aside.

lines.zh: 我边打边喊，叫人来帮忙。
lines.en: I fight and shout for someone to help.

lines.zh: 打完这架，我要涨你的价。
lines.en: After this fight, your prices go up.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我把摊子支起来。
lines.en: Day breaks; I set up my stall.

lines.zh: 新到的货还在车上，先卸。
lines.en: New goods are on the cart; unload first.

lines.zh: 我在这条街租了个角落。
lines.en: I rented a corner on this street.

lines.zh: 火药味引来第一个客人。
lines.en: The smell of powder draws my first customer.

lines.zh: 铺子开张，我先擦柜台。
lines.en: Opening day; I wipe the counter first.

lines.zh: 这地方够安静，适合做生意。
lines.en: This place is quiet enough for business.

lines.zh: 我把招牌挂上钉好的钩。
lines.en: I hang the sign on its fixed hook.

lines.zh: 仓库的钥匙还在我腰上。
lines.en: The storehouse key is still at my hip.

lines.zh: 有人往这边来了，我清清嗓子。
lines.en: Someone approaches; I clear my throat.

lines.zh: 第一次开张，我手都在抖。
lines.en: First day open, my hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 火药最怕火，别靠近。
lines.en: Powder fears fire most; stay back.

lines.zh: 摔下来，箱子先落地。
lines.en: Falling, the crate hits the ground first.

lines.zh: 我不会水，货也别下水。
lines.en: I cannot swim, and neither should my goods.

lines.zh: 这行最懂爆炸，我还活着。
lines.en: In this trade I know blasts; I am alive.

lines.zh: 这箭把我的袖口钉穿了。
lines.en: An arrow tore through my sleeve.

lines.zh: 魔法打的伤，药膏不管用。
lines.en: Magic wounds do not answer to salve.

lines.zh: 饿了半天，算盘都打错。
lines.en: Half a day hungry and my sums go wrong.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我头发竖了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my hair stands up.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，货也散了。
lines.en: Falling into void, my goods scatter too.
